statements.statement: The service was denied with reason code CO-50
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
Diagnosis codes I34.0 and R00.2 were submitted
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines
The clinical criteria for this specific diagnostic modality were not met
